<style type="text/css">/* === RESET & VARIABLES === */
.lpt-page {
  --slate-950: #0c0f17;
  --slate-900: #111827;
  --slate-800: #1e293b;
  --slate-700: #334155;
  --slate-500: #64748b;
  --slate-400: #94a3b8;
  --slate-300: #cbd5e1;
  --slate-200: #e2e8f0;
  --slate-100: #f1f5f9;
  --slate-50: #f8fafc;
  --white: #ffffff;
  --coral: #e8553d;
  --coral-light: #f4775f;
  --coral-dark: #c7412c;
  --coral-bg: rgba(232,85,61,0.06);
  --coral-border: rgba(232,85,61,0.15);
  --green: #16a34a;
  --green-bg: rgba(22,163,74,0.08);
  --green-border: rgba(22,163,74,0.15);
  --font-display: 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif;
  --font-body: 'Outfit', system-ui, sans-serif;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  color: var(--slate-800);
  line-height: 1.65;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
.lpt-page *, .lpt-page *::before, .lpt-page *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }

/* === UTILITIES === */
.lpt-section { padding: 4.5rem 1.5rem; }
.lpt-dark { background: var(--slate-950); color: var(--white); }
.lpt-light { background: var(--slate-50); }
.lpt-white { background: var(--white); }
.lpt-container { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; }
.lpt-eyebrow {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.74rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--coral); margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}
.lpt-dark .lpt-eyebrow { color: var(--coral-light); }
.lpt-stitle {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 3.2vw, 2.6rem);
  font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.15;
  color: var(--slate-900); margin: 0 0 1rem;
}
.lpt-dark .lpt-stitle { color: var(--white); }
.lpt-ssub {
  font-size: 1.02rem; color: var(--slate-500);
  max-width: 540px; line-height: 1.65; margin: 0;
}
.lpt-dark .lpt-ssub { color: var(--slate-400); }

/* === BUTTONS === */
.lpt-btn {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  padding: 15px 32px;
  font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600;
  border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.25s var(--ease);
}
.lpt-btn svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.lpt-btn-primary {
  background: var(--coral); color: var(--white);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(232,85,61,0.25);
}
.lpt-btn-primary:hover {
  background: var(--coral-dark); color: var(--white);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(232,85,61,0.3);
}
.lpt-btn-outline {
  background: transparent; color: var(--slate-700);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--slate-300);
}
.lpt-btn-outline:hover {
  border-color: var(--slate-400); background: var(--slate-50);
  transform: translateY(-1px); color: var(--slate-800);
}
.lpt-btn-white {
  background: var(--white); color: var(--coral);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
}
.lpt-btn-white:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
  color: var(--coral-dark);
}
.lpt-btn-ghost {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
}
.lpt-btn-ghost:hover {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); color: var(--white);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.lpt-btn-lg { padding: 17px 40px; font-size: 0.95rem; }

/* === HERO === */
.lpt-hero {
  padding: 4rem 1.5rem 3.5rem;
  background: var(--white); text-align: center;
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.lpt-hero::before {
  content: ''; position: absolute;
  top: -250px; right: -150px;
  width: 600px; height: 600px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(232,85,61,0.04) 0%, transparent 70%);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.lpt-hero-inner { max-width: 780px; margin: 0 auto; position: relative; z-index: 2; }
.lpt-hero-badge {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  padding: 6px 16px 6px 10px;
  background: var(--coral-bg); border: 1px solid var(--coral-border);
  border-radius: 100px; margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--coral);
}
.lpt-hero-badge .lpt-dot {
  width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--coral); animation: lptPulse 2s infinite;
}
@keyframes lptPulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
  50% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(1.4); }
}
.lpt-hero h1 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 4.5vw, 3.6rem);
  font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.1;
  color: var(--slate-900); margin: 0 0 1.5rem;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}
.lpt-hero h1 em { font-style: italic; color: var(--coral); }
.lpt-hero-sub {
  font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--slate-500);
  line-height: 1.7; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto 1.5rem;
}
.lpt-hero-credit {
  font-size: 0.92rem; color: var(--slate-500);
  line-height: 1.7; max-width: 580px; margin: 0 auto 2.5rem;
  padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--coral);
  background: var(--slate-50);
  border-radius: 0 10px 10px 0;
  text-align: left;
}
.lpt-hero-credit strong { color: var(--slate-800); font-weight: 600; }
.lpt-hero-actions {
  display: flex; gap: 14px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap;
}

/* === QUICK LINKS BAR === */
.lpt-quicklinks {
  display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding: 1rem 1.5rem; background: var(--slate-50);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
}
.lpt-quicklinks a {
  padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--slate-500);
  text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.2s;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}
.lpt-quicklinks a:hover {
  color: var(--coral); background: var(--white);
  border-color: var(--coral-border);
}

/* === PAIN GRID === */
.lpt-pain-grid {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 1px; background: var(--slate-200);
  border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; margin-top: 2.5rem;
}
.lpt-pain-card {
  background: var(--white); padding: 2rem 1.5rem;
  transition: all 0.3s var(--ease);
}
.lpt-pain-card:hover { background: var(--slate-50); }
.lpt-pain-icon {
  width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--coral-bg);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 1.1rem; color: var(--coral);
}
.lpt-pain-card h4 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 400; color: var(--slate-900);
  margin: 0 0 0.4rem;
}
.lpt-pain-card p { color: var(--slate-500); font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; }

/* === MODEL CARDS === */
.lpt-model-grid {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 16px; margin-top: 2.5rem;
}
.lpt-model-card {
  padding: 1.75rem 1.5rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
  transition: all 0.3s var(--ease);
}
.lpt-model-card:hover {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  border-color: rgba(232,85,61,0.25);
  transform: translateY(-3px);
}
.lpt-model-num {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  color: var(--coral-light); margin: 0 0 0.75rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.lpt-model-card h4 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--white); margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
}
.lpt-model-card p { color: var(--slate-400); font-size: 0.86rem; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; }
.lpt-model-note {
  text-align: center; margin-top: 2.5rem;
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.2rem; font-style: italic;
  color: var(--slate-400);
}

/* === DIFF CARDS === */
.lpt-diff-tag {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.15rem; font-style: italic;
  color: var(--coral); margin: 0 0 2.5rem;
}
.lpt-diff-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 14px; }
.lpt-diff-card {
  padding: 1.75rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
  border-radius: 14px; background: var(--white);
  transition: all 0.3s var(--ease); position: relative;
}
.lpt-diff-card::after {
  content: ''; position: absolute; top: 14px; left: 0;
  width: 3px; height: 26px; border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
  background: var(--coral); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s;
}
.lpt-diff-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--coral-border); transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 36px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
}
.lpt-diff-card:hover::after { opacity: 1; }
.lpt-diff-card h4 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--slate-900); margin: 0 0 0.4rem;
}
.lpt-diff-card p { color: var(--slate-500); font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.65; margin: 0; }
.lpt-diff-bottom {
  text-align: center; margin-top: 2.25rem;
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.25rem; color: var(--slate-800);
}
.lpt-diff-bottom em { font-style: italic; color: var(--coral); }

/* === COMPARISON TABLE === */
.lpt-compare-wrap { max-width: 880px; margin: 2.5rem auto 0; overflow-x: auto; }
.lpt-compare-wrap table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
.lpt-compare-wrap thead th {
  text-align: left; padding: 12px 18px;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--slate-200); color: var(--slate-500);
}
.lpt-compare-wrap thead th.lpt-hl {
  color: var(--coral); background: var(--coral-bg);
  border-bottom-color: var(--coral-border);
  border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0;
}
.lpt-compare-wrap tbody td {
  padding: 12px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--slate-100);
  font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--slate-700);
}
.lpt-compare-wrap tbody td:first-child { font-weight: 600; color: var(--slate-800); font-size: 0.86rem; }
.lpt-compare-wrap tbody td.lpt-hl { background: var(--coral-bg); font-weight: 600; color: var(--coral-dark); }
.lpt-tcheck { color: var(--green); font-weight: 700; }
.lpt-tx { color: var(--slate-400); }
.lpt-compare-note {
  text-align: center; margin-top: 1.75rem;
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1rem; font-style: italic;
  color: var(--slate-500); max-width: 560px;
  margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;
}

/* === CALCULATOR === */
.lpt-calc {
  max-width: 960px; margin: 2.5rem auto 0;
  padding: 2.25rem;
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
  border-radius: 16px;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
}
.lpt-calc h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.5rem; margin: 0 0 0.4rem; color: var(--slate-900);
}
.lpt-calc-sub {
  color: var(--slate-500); font-size: 0.9rem; margin: 0 0 1.75rem; line-height: 1.6;
}
.lpt-calc-sub strong { color: var(--slate-700); }
.lpt-calc-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 14px; }
.lpt-calc-group {
  padding: 1.5rem;
  background: var(--slate-50);
  border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
  border-radius: 12px;
}
.lpt-calc-group h4 {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--slate-500);
  margin: 0 0 0.75rem;
}
.lpt-calc-group label {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--slate-500);
  margin: 8px 0 4px; font-weight: 500;
}
.lpt-calc-group input {
  width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);

  }
